params.units: canvas convention: px y-down, degrees + = clockwise on screen. Unity: negate angles and dy.

helpers.env: env(ts,rise,hold,back): 0 before 0; ease(ts/rise) rising; 1 until hold; 1-ease((ts-hold)/back) after; 0 after hold+back

spring_model.target: idle_amp_deg*sin(2*pi*t/period_s - idle_phase_rad) + driver target (wings, hair gravity)
spring_model.a: world acceleration (px/s^2, canvas y-down) of the bone head incl. groove, lean, recoil and 0.6*camera offset
spring_model.u: current world unit direction of the bone (head->tail)
spring_model.output: phi_shown = soft_limit*tanh(phi/soft_limit); internal phi clamped to +-2*soft_limit
spring_model.warmup: reference pre-rolls 24 s; pre-roll a few seconds at start

chest_spring.law: acc = -wn^2*c - 2*z*wn*v - (gain_x*a.x, gain_y*a.y); a = acceleration of chest point (540,560); shown = lim*tanh(c/lim)

skill.glint: ts 0.10..0.58: u=(ts-0.10)/0.48 travels along glint_arc (Halberd space), strength sin(pi*u)
skill.banner: ts 0.1..1.6 (ease in 0.12s, out from 1.3s over 0.3s) — battle UI, not part of the rig

hit.recoil: r = ease(th/0.07) for th<0.07, then max(-0.25, dspring(th-0.07,1.6,6.5))
hit.face: Hurt for th in [0, 0.4) (frames 204-215 @30fps = 6.80-7.17 s), hard cut in (under the flash) and hard cut out
hit.label: phase 被ダメ for th 0..0.9

panel_look.rim: red rim light on the right cutout edge: edge=blur(alpha - alpha shifted 6px left, 2px)*alpha; c += edge*(150,30,25)*0.9
